description:
E-mail phishing simulation templates in one language: name, category, difficulty, QR-code flag,
        titles of the red flags employees learn to spot, and the course assigned to repeat clickers.
        Metadata only (no e-mail bodies, no links). Optional filters: category, difficulty. Paginated:
        limit (1-100, default 20) and offset; the result includes total and next_offset.

category.description: Category key (as listed by get_template_categories); omitted: all categories.
category.title: Category

language.description: Catalogue AND answer language: 'fr' lists the French templates (what French-speaking employees receive), 'en' the English ones.
language.title: Language

offset.description: Number of results to skip (next_offset of the previous page).
offset.title: Offset

name: list_simulation_templates
title: Phishing simulation templates
